53	/** Plain text visible to the end user. */
54	export interface TextBlock {
55	  type: 'text'

59	/** Reasoning / thinking content, distinct from visible text. */
60	export interface ReasoningBlock {

65	/**
66	 * A durable raster image reference, valid in user or assistant content. The
67	 * block is deliberately role-neutral; assistant-side rendering is forward
68	 * compatibility — the current production adapters declare text-only output,
69	 * so only user messages may carry images.
70	 */
71	export interface ImageBlock {
72	  type: 'image'
73	  /** Immutable bytes and intrinsic display metadata owned by the attachment service. */
74	  attachment: ImageAttachmentRef
75	}

95	/**
96	 * Merge-extensible content blocks keyed by `type`. New core blocks must land
97	 * with adapter, UI, and compaction support.
98	 */
99	export interface ContentBlockMap {
100	  'text': TextBlock
101	  'reasoning': ReasoningBlock
102	  'image': ImageBlock
103	  'tool-call': ToolCallBlock
104	  'tool-result': ToolResultBlock
105	}

107	/** The block `type` tag vocabulary; widens as plugins add entries to {@link ContentBlockMap}. */
108	export type ContentBlockType = keyof ContentBlockMap
109	/** Any known content block, derived from {@link ContentBlockMap}; switch on `type` and fall through unknowns (merge-extensible). */
110	export type ContentBlock = ContentBlockMap[ContentBlockType]
